name: magic-ui-bento-grid

frames.best_why: All five tiles are fully in frame with their previews and most Learn more links visible.

tagline: Five dark feature tiles preview search, files, calendar and more.
summary: A bento-style feature grid where each dark tile pairs a title with a small live-looking preview of that feature; hovering lifts the text and reveals a link.
appearance: A three-column mosaic of dark rounded cards on black, each with an icon, a bold title, a short caption and a background illustration: search results, a mini calendar, a scrolling file list, language chips and a notification stack.
behaviour: Hovering a card lifts its title block, shrinks its icon and slides a "Learn more" link into view from the bottom. Background previews such as the file list drift sideways in a loop.
demo_content: Feature tiles named Full text search, Calendar, Save your files, Multilingual and Notifications.
search_phrases: cards that reveal a link on hover
dark tiles arranged in a mosaic
use_when: A product page needs to show several features at once with a glimpse of each in action.
avoid_when: Small screens: the demo relies on fixed column spans and stacks tall when narrow.
customise: Each card takes an icon, name, description, link, CTA label and a background node; grid spans and row heights come from classes.
weight_why: Several looping background marquees of duplicated file cards plus hover transitions.

a11y.note: Desktop Learn more links stay invisible until hover, so keyboard users can focus an unseen link.

issues: On desktop the Learn more link is invisible but still keyboard-focusable.
polish_why: Rich, well-composed bento layout; the stacked previews and tiny paragraphs make it busy.
